---
title: "📁 Output files"
---

Every file name ends in the random seed passed with `--random_seed`. The Stage column matches the [commands](commands.qmd).

| File | Stage | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ts_{seed}.trees` | 1 | Tree sequence (no mutations) — always written |
| `sim_ind_node_map_{seed}.csv` | 1 | Host → strain node mapping, with each node's `time` (generations before present) — always written |
| `node_pairs_{seed}.csv` | 1 | Recombinant node pairs from same meiosis |
| `lineage_{seed}.csv` | 1 | Per-generation child→parent strain lineage, pre-simplify node IDs, one row per inherited genome segment (`left`, `right`) (`--save_lineage`) |
| `node_id_map_{seed}.csv` | 1 | Pre-simplify → post-simplify node ID mapping (`--save_lineage`) |
| `ts_mut_{seed}.trees` | 2 | Tree sequence with mutations |
| `coal_T_{seed}.csv` | 3 | Pairwise coalescence times per tree interval (chromosome-local coordinates) |
| `mut_T_{seed}.csv` | 3 | Mutation chromosome, position, and age |
| `output_{seed}_strain.vcf` | 4 | Per-strain genotypes (0/1) |
| `output_{seed}_host_depth.vcf` | 5 | Per-host genotypes (0/0, 0/1, 1/1; e.g. 1/2 at multi-allelic sites; ./. with no reads) with read counts per allele, from realistic read depth (a depth file or the depth model); the header records the depth source, the model values used and the error rates (`--error_wt_mut`, `--error_mut_wt`) |
| `host_depth_profiles_{seed}.csv` | 5 | Each host's depth source. With `--depth_zip`: `sim_id`, `ind_id`, `sample` and `depth_file` (its name in the zip). With `--depth_model`: `sim_id`, `ind_id`, `depth_model` and `typical_depth` (the host's drawn typical depth) |
| `host_depth_proportions_{seed}.csv` | 5 | Dirichlet strain proportions per host |
| `strain_transmission_map_{seed}.html` | additional | Interactive pedigree with mutations; explore it by chromosome and tree |
| `pairwise_strain_pedigree_map_{seed}.html` | additional | Interactive pedigree coalescence trace for any two strains |
| `relate_strain_{seed}.csv` | stats | Pairwise strain IBD fraction (`krsim relate-strain`) |
| `relate_host_{seed}.csv` | stats | Average pairwise IBD fraction per host, most recent generation only (`krsim relate-host`) |
| `KR_sim_{seed}.log` | all | Run log — every command adds a block with the time, krsim version, exact command line, files written and run time (and the full error details if it fails) |
